correctness.rationale: Conditional on coupon-label history to full appearance, each type’s final refresh mark is independent stationary Bernoulli(p_i), independent of the label history and future marks. Thus C_m and W_m are independent. Poissonization with independent rate-one clocks gives all-present return kernel H_m(e^-t), and renewal at stationary hit yields a0/[s∫u^(s−1)H_m(u)du]. Max diffuse p→0 and bounded sum imply H_m→exp(c(u−1))∏(1−q_j+q_j u) uniformly; dominated convergence proves Laplace convergence. The continuous-time immigration–death plus finite flags process identifies a proper limit and the atom at zero. Gumbel coupon collector plus exact independence yields stated sum. Independent exact rational subset-state hitting equations reproduce finite PGF examples.

originality.rationale: Attrill–Garoni Theorem 4.10 already supplies common-loss p_m with mp_m→c and its Gumbel+immigration–death law; that r=0 homogeneous special case is not novel. The new statement allows arbitrary asymptotically diffuse loss profiles plus finitely many macroscopic exceptional types, identifies their survival as distinct two-state components and gives exact heterogeneous PGF. Published nonuniform global-reset coupon models have different sampling and reset mechanics.
